n "Chakorer Pream," witness the poignant tale of the house owner's daughter who finds love with a servant, unveiling the depths of a father's cruelty in the name of honour and the anguish a father endures when his daughter flees home. Through Tejya's sacrifice for her father's pride, the narrative reflects the profound bonds between parents and children. As the season draws to a close, it prompts every youth to ponder whom they shouldn't leave behind with unresolved sorrow in their parent's absence.
